## Oak Exploratory data analysis and cleaning

```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

library(readxl)
Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  read_excel("Oak Project/Data/Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7&6Clean.xlsx", 
                                                   sheet = "Input1", skip = 1)
View(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean)

names(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean)
```

```{r}
Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <-
  Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean |> 
  rename(Page_Num = "Page #",
         Date = "MM/DD/YYYY",
         Recorder ="Name",
        Block ="#...4",
        Tag_Num = "#...5",
        Oak_Type ="NR, S, or A",
        Treatment ="AC, OA, NP, DT, or DL",
         OA_Microclimate ="TH, TI, CN",
        Seedling_Height ="(cm)",
        Leaves_Num ="#...10",
        Dead_Leaves_Num ="#...11",
        Leaf_Greenness ="%",
        Germination_Num ="#...13",
        RCD ="(mm)",
       Notes  ="as written on data sheet")
```

Changing columns to be numeric

```{r}
str(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean)

Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean |> 
  mutate(Seedling_Height = as.numeric(Seedling_Height))

str(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean)

Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean |> 
  mutate(Leaves_Num = as.numeric(Leaves_Num))


Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean |> 
  mutate(Dead_Leaves_Num = as.numeric(Dead_Leaves_Num))


Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean |> 
  mutate(Leaf_Greenness = as.numeric(Leaf_Greenness))

Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean |> 
  mutate(Germination_Num = as.numeric(Germination_Num))

Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean <- 
  Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean |> 
  mutate(RCD = as.numeric(RCD))


str(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean)


```

Going to check data for any outliers

```{r}
ggplot(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean) +
  aes(x = Seedling_Height) + 
  geom_bar()


which(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean$Seedling_Height == 60)
#Row 12 is a huge outlier, may consider removing 

ggplot(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean) +
  aes(x = RCD) + 
  geom_bar()
#RCD has a patch at 7.5 that could be removed


```

Going to check on repeat entries

```{r}
unique(Survival_HeightApril26Blocks7_6Clean$Tag_Num)
#Looks like there are no repeat entries
```
